text:
Good evening! The showers that drifted through this afternoon have been light, and the sky is still socked in as we head toward sunset a little before 4:40. With this much cloud, I wouldn't expect much of a color show. A leftover sprinkle is possible until about 8, but it would add up to well under a tenth of an inch. After that it stays mostly cloudy and unusually mild. We only slip to around 55 overnight, so you can leave the heavy coat at home.

Tomorrow is the surprise. A warm southerly flow and a drier slot of air bring mostly sunny skies and a high near 73, close to record territory for November. Most of that warmth comes early, and we ease back to around 67 by afternoon. It will be a bit breezy and quite dry, so go easy with anything that could spark a brush fire. Wednesday night stays mild and gets breezier.

The warmth doesn't last. A weak front brings scattered, light showers Thursday, so tomorrow is the day for a long walk or ride.
